summary: Backend testing completed successfully. All 16 tests pass (100%). Verified: (1) Generators seed data is clean - exactly 3 generators exist (مولد 150/250/300 kVA) with correct capacities, (2) Invoice model no longer contains amperage_charge - full flow (customer -> reading -> invoice) works with only consumption_charge and total_amount equals consumption_charge, (3) Invoice endpoint accepts payload without amperage_charge (200), validates missing consumption_charge (422), and safely ignores/rejects legacy amperage_charge field, (4) Dashboard reports total_generators=3, (5) All CRUD & report endpoints (customers, invoices, readings, expenses, reports/debts, reports/financial, reports/consumption) return 200.

minor.issue: Extra fields (e.g., legacy amperage_charge) are silently ignored due to default Pydantic behavior. Consider adding `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on InvoiceCreate to catch stale clients.
total_amount is trusted from client instead of being computed server-side from consumption_charge + previous_balance. Recommended to compute on server to prevent mismatch.
No auth guard on any endpoint - all endpoints are public. Only login is validated but no token/session is returned or required.

action_items: (Optional) Compute total_amount server-side from consumption_charge + previous_balance to prevent client tampering.
(Optional) Add Pydantic `extra='forbid'` on InvoiceCreate to reject legacy amperage_charge field explicitly.
(Security - out of current scope) Login endpoint returns no token; API is unauthenticated. Consider JWT for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `.dict()` (Pydantic v1) and `@app.on_event('shutdown')` - both deprecated in Pydantic v2 / FastAPI lifespan API. Non-blocking.
Login credentials are hardcoded in server.py rather than from env vars. OK for MVP but flag for production.
InvoiceCreate.total_amount is provided by client instead of derived from consumption_charge; risk of inconsistency.
server.py is 685 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers per resource.
seed_data_creation: Tests created temporary TEST_ customers and cleaned them up via DELETE. Also created 1-2 test invoices/readings tied to those customers (readings are not deleted by cascade, but their customer is deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend baseline: 3 seed generators, InvoiceCreate no longer has amperage_charge. Frontend not tested this iteration - if frontend testing requested, verify invoice creation UI no longer shows amperage field and displays USD instead of IQD.
